howto_text_before: Every day, a Wikipedia article is chosen as the mystery article. Your goal is to find it. Type any Wikipedia article title to make a guess. For example, if you guess Marie Curie, you might see:
howto_text_after: The number 6 means Marie Curie and the mystery article have 6 links in common. Your guesses are sorted from most to least common links: the higher a guess is in the list, the closer it is to the mystery article.
